text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's enough studying for now.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Actually… I think I've got time for one more quick book before training…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: (I know I shouldn't push myself too hard… But this is nothing for the future number one.)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Right, what should I read? Aha! I know just the thing to help me with my next race…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Phew… I really got sucked in there. There's only a little bit left… Let's see how I'm doing for time…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What?! It's been an hour! B-but that means… training's already started!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But there's only a few pages left! And I feel like I'm on the brink of an epiphany… Trainer won't mind, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, Daiwa Scarlet ends up so fixated on the idea of being number one that she skips training…
